名称：Recruitment Fraud
领域：recruitment_fraud
版本：1
方案标识：ruleset-proposal:b056828b7a8c4486a3cb44ce331da4a2
内容指纹：ff7cec3922e2b173b669c7dd366d1008f8a5a8fc974d74ecc9f211da1d187861
研判目标：Assess recruitment advance fees and fabricated job offers from the supplied evidence.
分类数：2；规则数：4
通用豁免：
- Education（recruitment.education）
  条件：Educational reporting without soliciting applicants or payments.

分类：Advance fees（recruitment.advance_fee，排序 10）
说明：

规则 1：Payment demand（recruitment.fee_request）
启用：是；排序：1
命中条件：Require an applicant to transfer a deposit before receiving a job offer.
建议风险：high
应用阶段：image_evidence, video_frame_evidence, comment_audit, fusion_audit
裁决说明：Metadata only: fee review.
规则豁免：
- Refund record（recruitment.refund）
  条件：The record only documents returning a previously collected fee.

规则 2：Unclear fee（recruitment.unclear_fee）
启用：是；排序：2
命中条件：An ambiguous service fee is mentioned without a payment request.
建议风险：low
应用阶段：comment_audit
裁决说明：Metadata only: ambiguity.
规则豁免：无

分类：Fabricated offers（recruitment.fake_offer，排序 20）
说明：

规则 3：Offer promise（recruitment.offer_promise）
启用：是；排序：1
命中条件：Promise guaranteed employment while presenting a demonstrably fabricated employer offer.
建议风险：medium
应用阶段：image_evidence, video_frame_evidence, fusion_audit
裁决说明：Metadata only: offer review.
规则豁免：
- Sample offer（recruitment.sample）
  条件：The offer is explicitly marked as a fictional training sample.

规则 4：Disabled rule（recruitment.disabled）
启用：否；排序：2
命中条件：DISABLED_EXECUTION_SENTINEL
建议风险：high
应用阶段：image_evidence, video_frame_evidence, comment_audit, fusion_audit
裁决说明：Metadata only: disabled.
规则豁免：无
